learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparing numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected 0% gravity and locked it in.
observations.exploration: Visited 400 km: 88.5%; 6371 km: 25%; 20200 km: 5.7%; 35786 km: 2.3%. Threw at 3 km/s from 400 km, stepped twice by three minutes: hit ground 961 km away, predicted hit time 5.5 minutes. Threw at 7.67 km/s, stepped three minutes: still missing. Reveal unlocked. Height history retained.
observations.reveal: Corrected about 90%, links radius doubling to quarter gravity and 400 km adding only 6% centre distance. Slow throw hits while ISS-speed throw keeps missing; astronauts and station fall together.
observations.visual: Inline screenshots inspected. Final orange circular path surrounds green Earth; station square and ball dot share orbit; gravity bar remains almost full at 88.5%. Caption heights stretched sixfold, round Earth, no air. Trust count 8/8 ignored.
observations.isolation: No-history evaluation preview banner present. Visible trust count ignored.
observations.reference: Own CUA tab 543884122 snapshots and inspected inline screenshot; no screenshot file saved.
